events.title: RSA public-key cryptosystem is introduced
events.summary: Ron Rivest, Adi Shamir and Leonard Adleman issued the MIT technical report describing the RSA public-key cryptosystem; the journal paper followed in 1978.
events.significance: RSA became one of the foundational public-key encryption and signature systems used throughout secure computing.

sources.title: A Method for Obtaining Digital Signatures and Public-key Cryptosystems
